scope: Performance changes in the existing working tree; prior changes preserved. Installed and tested on the Moondrop.

changes.type_icons: Three initial/cue-driven captures 200 ms apart; recovery probe every 1.5 s without treating an earlier classification as certain. Independent sides; entry, faint, cry and Match-start cues reopen the burst.
changes.charged_labels: Exact bright neutral letter-pixel comparisons reuse an OCR result for at most 5 s (blank: 1 s). New evidence cites the fresh crop and the original OCR crop, with UNCHANGED_LETTER_PIXELS basis. Any changed letter pixel forces OCR. No change to touch inference freshness rules.
changes.ocr_queue: Optional pointer checks only enter an idle recognizer. Routine label work older than 1 s is skipped at admission, allowing the newest conflated crop to be tried. Preserved results alternate newest and oldest candidates rather than waiting behind the entire result backlog. Original times and raw artifacts remain intact.
changes.checkpoints: 15-second cadence retained. Append-only SHA-256-checked, fsynced batches of new articles replace recurring full ZIP rewrites. Content-addressed source artifacts remain durable separately. On process restart, background recovery validates batches and packages a compact replay archive. Incomplete tails and corrupt journals are preserved; legacy ZIP checkpoints remain recoverable. Archive Directory and Match Summary already refresh every second, so recovered files appear without leaving the screen.
changes.zip: Already-compressed PNG bytes use DEFLATE level 0; Timeline JSON and audio retain normal compression. Artifact size, SHA-256 and ZIP validation remain.
changes.audio: One resampling pass per fast-move clip. A bounded 2048-window shared spectral cache compares every PCM sample before reusing overlapping data. Fast-move and stat-change readers normalize independent copies. Goertzel centroid replaces the equivalent direct DFT without per-sample trigonometry. Raw audio, attribution, candidate thresholds and counts remain independent.
changes.hp: Capture rate, calibration, measurements, buffer ownership and high-rate HP processing unchanged. Shared-buffer redesign deferred until a simultaneous live profile justifies the risk.
